rules.text: Click handlers go on buttons and links, not on divs or spans, so keyboard and screen reader users can reach them.
Keep a visible focus style. If you remove the outline, add a replacement such as `focus-visible:ring-2`.
Icon-only buttons need an aria-label that says what they do.
Images need alt text that describes them. Use alt="" for images that are only decoration.
Every input needs a label. A placeholder isn't a label, because it disappears as soon as someone types.
Text needs at least 4.5:1 contrast with its background; large text (24px, or about 19px and bold), icons and form borders need 3:1. On white, body text uses `gray-500` or darker.
Icons and form borders on `white` use `gray-500` or darker (needs 3:1).
Behind `gray-500` text, use a `gray-50` background or lighter (needs 4.5:1).
Behind `white` text, use a `blue-600` background or darker (needs 4.5:1).
Use `<Button variant="primary">` for the main action on a page and `<Button>` for other actions; never a raw `<button>`.
Only use spacing tokens (4, 8, 10, 12, 16, 24, 32px); no arbitrary values like `p-[2px]`.
